about:
Standard Supply Electronics operates from South Salt Lake, Utah. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It functions as an independent distributor affiliated with the Edge Group, a Houston-based buying and marketing collective of more than 100 independent distributors.

The company stocks and sells a broad range of electronic components and supplies, including soldering equipment, connectors, transistors, cables, heat-shrink tubing, diodes, batteries, fuses, tools, capacitors, banana plugs, and resistors. Through its Edge Group membership, it accesses a combined inventory of over 200 product lines and thousands of individual items. Sales channels include a proprietary online store, as well as Amazon and eBay storefronts.

Standard Supply Electronics serves customers in the datacom, security, low-voltage, electronic MRO (maintenance, repair, and operations), and electronic OEM (original equipment manufacturer) sectors. Its buyer base includes contractors, maintenance departments, and OEMs sourcing components for assembly or repair.

The company emphasizes that its Edge Group affiliation allows it to leverage the collective purchasing power and inventory of a national distributor network, enabling it to source hard-to-find parts and offer competitive pricing on a wide product range.
